name: Shahverdi Sultan
contribution: A Safavid military leader of Turkoman origin, who served as the governor of Karabakh and Ganja during the reign of Shah Tahmasp I.

checks.lead: Gokcheh Sultan Ziyadoghlu Qajar (Persian: گکچه سلطان زیاداوغلی قاجار), better known as Shahverdi Sultan (شاهوردی سلطان), was a Safavid military leader of Turkoman origin, who served as the governor of Karabakh and Ganja during the reign of Shah Tahmasp I (r. 1524–1576).
